TABLE.NAME: googlemeet
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the googlemeet activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance.

FIELD.NAME: originalname
FIELD.COMMENT: The original name of the activity module instance.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: The URL of room.

FIELD.NAME: creatoremail
FIELD.COMMENT: Email from the Google account that created the room.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: lastsync
FIELD.COMMENT: The last time this activity was synced to Google Drive.

FIELD.NAME: eventdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated date retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: starthour
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated start hour retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: startminute
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated start minute retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: endhour
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated end hour retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: endminute
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated end minute retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: addmultiply
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated recurrence flag retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: days
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated recurrence weekdays retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: period
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated recurrence interval retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: eventenddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated recurrence end retained for old backup compatibility.

FIELD.NAME: notify
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to send notification to the student.

FIELD.NAME: minutesbefore
FIELD.COMMENT: When the notification should be send.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: Legacy Calendar link identifier. This is not a Calendar API event ID.

FIELD.NAME: integrationmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Meeting integration mode: manual, legacy or managed.

FIELD.NAME: owneruserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user who owns the Google authorization.

FIELD.NAME: oauthissuerid
FIELD.COMMENT: OAuth 2 issuer selected for the integration.

FIELD.NAME: calendarid
FIELD.COMMENT: Google Calendar identifier.

FIELD.NAME: googleeventid
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque Calendar API event identifier.

FIELD.NAME: googleeventhtmlurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Google Calendar event page.

FIELD.NAME: googleeventetag
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar API event entity tag.

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: Idempotency identifier for conference creation.

FIELD.NAME: conferenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Google conference identifier.

FIELD.NAME: meetingcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Normalized Google Meet meeting code.

FIELD.NAME: meetinguri
FIELD.COMMENT: URI used to join the meeting.

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute meeting start timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute meeting end timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timezone
FIELD.COMMENT: IANA timezone used for the meeting.

FIELD.NAME: recurrence
FIELD.COMMENT: Normalized recurrence rule.

FIELD.NAME: sendupdates
FIELD.COMMENT: Google Calendar guest notification policy.

FIELD.NAME: syncstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Current synchronization state.

FIELD.NAME: conferencestatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Conference creation state returned by Google.

FIELD.NAME: syncattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of synchronization attempts.

FIELD.NAME: lasterrorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Sanitized code from the last synchronization error.

FIELD.NAME: lasterrormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Sanitized message from the last synchronization error.

FIELD.NAME: timelastattempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last synchronization attempt.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the activity was created.

FIELD.NAME: recordingowneruserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user who owns the recording authorization.

FIELD.NAME: recordingoauthissuerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Dedicated OAuth issuer used for recording discovery.

FIELD.NAME: recordingsyncstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Current recording discovery state.

FIELD.NAME: recordingsyncattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of recording discovery attempts.

FIELD.NAME: recordinglasterrorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Sanitized code from the last recording discovery error.

FIELD.NAME: recordinglasterrormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Sanitized recording discovery error message.

FIELD.NAME: recordingtimelastattempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last recording discovery attempt.

FIELD.NAME: occurrencekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable key derived from the canonical occurrence start.

FIELD.NAME: eventdate
FIELD.COMMENT: The date of the event.

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: The duration of the event.

FIELD.NAME: calendareventid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle Calendar event reconciled for this occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

TABLE.NAME: googlemeet_recordings
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores references from Google Meet recordings.

FIELD.NAME: recordingid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the video in Google Drive.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the video.

FIELD.NAME: createdtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the video creation date.

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Duration of the video.

FIELD.NAME: webviewlink
FIELD.COMMENT: Video preview link.

FIELD.NAME: visible
FIELD.COMMENT: If the recording should be visible.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

TABLE.NAME: googlemeet_notify_done
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores receipts for meeting reminders sent to users.

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the reminder was sent.
